exact_scope.price_rule: current_price and price_observed_at are present together and their timestamps equal
exact_scope.serialization_rule: unordered serialization is not a public order claim

RIGHTS_GATE.basis: title and price have direct-support display decisions; transparency notice is a local required disclosure

LIFECYCLE_GATE.basis: confirmed lifecycle policy plus current sanitized candidate evidence; this is not publication permission

SEMANTICS_GATE.basis: only timestamped unordered facts are considered; no ranking, order, offset, update, or history meaning is asserted

DATA_POLICY_GATE.basis: packet schema is allowlisted and excludes identifiers, URLs, affiliate values, and prohibited claims

ARTIFACT_MANUAL_REVIEW_GATE.basis: sanitized packet review evidence records 100 valid candidates, exact notice, timestamp pairing, and closed activation flags

PRODUCTION_READINESS_GATE.basis: no separately reviewed public renderer, artifact validation, production build, deployment preflight, or explicit activation approval exists

minimum_future_gate_mutation_diff: add a dedicated exact-scope artifact validator that rejects any field, claim, control, or route behavior outside this evidence
record separate passing artifact validation, production build, and deployment preflight evidence without changing the existing global Publication Gate
make a separately reviewed atomic scoped-gate change only after explicit user approval names the exact artifact hash and production target

rollback.if_future_scoped_gate_is_approved: atomically restore the scoped gate to CLOSED and withdraw the exact artifact and route together

expiry_conditions: packet hash or contract version changes
candidate data is older than its allowed freshness window
any allowed field loses same-observation provenance
any excluded field, claim, CTA, ordering implication, or activation is introduced
official policy or support response changes
explicit_user_approval_required_for: the exact production artifact and target route
the scoped gate value change and its rollback owner
production build and deployment preflight execution
any expansion beyond the exact scope
